records.subject: Welcome aboard, Clearwater Group
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

Glad to have Clearwater Group on Wrenfield. A good first step is setting up one real project with your actual tasks rather than a test one -- it makes the rest of the product click faster.

Let me know if you'd like a hand.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Clearwater Group* just joined on the pro plan!

decisions.rationale: First project reached day 1 (2026-09-19) but no activity since; no invites sent, no tickets, and two Wrenfield emails ([email:a31d0c8d], [email:b7f61721]) went unanswered, suggesting low engagement. Pro plan and early project setup give some chance within the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: One next step for Clearwater Group
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

Following up on my last note — you got your first project set up, which is the main thing. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding your real tasks there is usually what makes the rest click.

If it would help, I'm happy to jump on a short call this week to look at how you've set things up and talk through the best next step for your team.

Best,
Chidi
